en.faq.title: Questions buyers ask
en.faq.q1: Will it work with my old monitor?
en.faq.a1: If your device has HDMI and the monitor only has VGA - yes. The cable is an active converter that turns HDMI into VGA directly.
en.faq.q2: Do I need to install a driver?
en.faq.a2: No - plug and play with no drivers, as active converter listings state.
en.faq.a3: No - VGA carries video only. Audio comes from another output on the device (speaker or HDMI to speakers).
en.faq.a4: The spec sheet names notebooks, PCs, laptops, DVD players, a Nintendo Switch, TVs, projectors and monitors - excluding some Apple devices and PS2/3, Xbox.
en.faq.q5: Can I pay cash on delivery?
